propositions: When plan review reuse fires on unchanged plans via idempotent_reuse (PASS path), the returned verdict synthesizes empty blocking/advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists and zero counts instead of replaying the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar findings.
The verdict_reuse (BLOCK path) already replays stored advisory/coaching from the latest sidecar with reused notation, establishing the desired behavior shape that idempotent_reuse must follow.

CLI output must render a clear notation stating the findings are the last review's result replayed against an unchanged plan (not a fresh LLM run), include --force pointer, and show the stored review's recency anchor (verified_at_sha/timestamp) when available.

The sidecar replay must fail-open: if the sidecar is absent, unreadable, mismatched on material fingerprint, or contradictory to attestation validity, degrade to empty-list behavior and preserve the attestation as the validity authority.

Machine-readable output must maintain coverage.llm_ran=False, idempotent_skip/verdict_reuse flags, runner="reused", and populate replayed findings in the same fields a fresh review would use, passing structured validation.
